scope.impact: Actual published ordered range and paths independently match API. Parent advancement changes only two documentation files not touched by child; executable/workflow/configuration input unchanged. Existing child tests remain applicable to executable contracts; not relabeled as hosted CI on new target. Fourth commit changes only retirement admission, OTA approval location and their maintained tests/documentation; previous three commits retain their identities. No product evidence/history churn.
